name: io.github.noahowsh/fastballapi
title: FastballAPI
description: MLB since 2015 plus college: pitches, plate appearances, box scores, odds by book. REST and MCP.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your FastballAPI API key. Get a free key with 500 credits at fastballapi.com/signup

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Team ids, abbreviations and colours for a season

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Find players by name

tools.name: get_games
tools.description: Games with runs, hits and errors by season, date, range or team

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming games with the median line across sportsbooks

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Standings from every final game, with run differential and Pythagorean record

tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: The latest injury report

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Our team Elo ratings, ranked

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: One game: every batting and pitching line, each book's line, win probability

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Season batting (AVG, OBP, SLG, OPS, RE24) and pitching (ERA, WHIP, K/9)

tools.name: get_player_games
tools.description: A player's full batting and pitching game log

tools.name: get_leaders
tools.description: Season leaders among qualified batters and pitchers

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Runs for and against, team batting and opponents' batting

tools.name: get_pitch_mix
tools.description: A pitcher's arsenal: usage, velocity, whiff rate per pitch type

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Every sportsbook's moneyline, run line and total for a game (5) or a day (10)

tools.name: get_plate_appearances
tools.description: Plate-appearance play-by-play with base-out state, batted ball, win probability, RE24

tools.name: get_pitches
tools.description: Pitch-by-pitch: count, type, velocity, location, result

tools.name: get_spray_chart
tools.description: Where a batter or team hits the ball, by trajectory and field

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Snapshots of each sportsbook's line before first pitch

tools.name: get_player_props
tools.description: Player prop lines by sportsbook, opening and closing

tools.name: get_prop_history
tools.description: A player's prop lines against the result, game by game
